scripts.dev: concurrently -n sdk,app -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w packages/stacksleuth-sdk" "npm run dev -w apps/stacksleuth-app"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/stacksleuth-sdk && npm run build -w apps/stacksleuth-app
scripts.start: concurrently -n sdk,app -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w packages/stacksleuth-sdk" "npm run start -w apps/stacksleuth-app"
